item.title: Full Stack Developer (Python/React)
item.description:
About the project
A service-oriented EnergyTech platform for electricity trading, consumption-data aggregation, and market hedging across energy markets. Built on multiple Django/DRF backends with React SPAs on top, plus AI/LLM-assisted analytics and a customer portal with enterprise SSO. The product is live and revenue-generating - we’re building out new services and setting modern development standards.

Responsibilities:
— Develop backend services with Python, Django + DRF;
— Build React SPAs (Vite, MUI, Recharts);
— Work with business logic and cross-service integrations;
— Implement AI/LLM features using LangChain + OpenAI;
— Write and maintain tests.

Required skills:
— 1+ years of commercial experience as a Full-stack/Software Developer;
— Strong Python, Django and DRF;
— React and JavaScript/TypeScript;
— PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery;
— Third-party API integration;
— Git and testing;
— Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar);
— English: Upper-intermediate or higher.

Will be a plus:
— LangChain / OpenAI or other LLM integration;
— Vite, MUI, Recharts;
— Azure, Docker, CI/CD.

We offer:
— Opportunities for career growth and personal development, to help you improve your skills and achieve your goals;
— No micromanagement - your ideas and initiatives are always encouraged;
— Educational programs that are covered by the company at 30% of the expense;
— Paid vacation leave and public holidays (21 vacation days annually);
— Competitive financial compensation with regular performance reviews;
— Outdoor team activities are paid for by the company;
— English language improvement through extensive communication;
— The chance to work alongside highly experienced and enthusiastic IT professionals who are ready to share their knowledge and help you gain invaluable experience in a live IT environment.

item.title: Vibe Coder, Frontend / AI-Assisted Developer
item.description:
NexaPay (nexapay.one) is an Estonian fintech company in the payments space. Our payment gateway allows merchants to accept Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and receive settlement in USDC. We work with B2B clients worldwide.

We're scaling and looking for a developer who can build high-quality web interfaces fast, making active use of modern AI development tools. We need someone who can take an idea to a working, well-designed product in a short time — and who genuinely understands what they're building.

What you'll do
— Build and develop the company's websites and landing pages, from mockup to production
— Create internal interfaces and panels for the team
— Maintain, improve and update existing pages and functionality
— Test ideas quickly: build prototypes and take the successful ones to completion
— Own the quality: responsiveness, load speed, correct behaviour across all devices

What matters to us
— A strong sense of modern UI/UX: you build interfaces that look polished and expensive, not templated. This is a key requirement
— Portfolio required: live links to websites or interfaces you've built
— Confident use of AI development tools (Claude Code or similar) — and a clear sense of where they can be trusted and where your own review is needed
— Real understanding of code, not just generation: project structure, working with repositories and Git, deployment, reading and editing existing code, a working grasp of backend and APIs
— Experience with a modern frontend stack (React/Next.js or similar)
— English at B2+: documentation, tools and part of our communication are in English
— Independence: the ability to take a task, see it through, and propose a better solution
— Attention to detail: this is fintech, where accuracy and reliability matter more than speed

Nice to have
— Experience in fintech, SaaS or with payment integrations
— Basic understanding of web application security
— Experience working with analytics and SEO requirements at the markup level

Hiring process
Portfolio review → interview → a test task

Schedule
Full-time, 9:00–19:00 Estonian time (EET), fully remote.

What we offer
— Competitive compensation, paid in crypto
— Fully remote work
— Freedom in technical decisions and a fast cycle: your changes reach real clients immediately
— An international fintech product that's actively scaling
— Room to grow with the company

Send your CV along with links to 2–3 things you've built — that matters more to us than formal experience.

item.title: Strong Junior Full-Stack JavaScript developer
item.description:
We’re expanding our engineering team and looking for developers who are comfortable building production-grade React and Node.js applications for early-stage companies in healthcare, fintech, and AI.

Although the role is primarily front-end oriented, the ability to contribute to backend services in Node.js is important.

You’ll join a team with clear processes, a modern stack, and a strong engineering culture.

 

What you will do

  • Create web applications using React and related tools.
  • Develop and support backend services and APIs with Node.js (Nest.js or similar frameworks).
  • Work with cloud platforms and container tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP.
  • Join architecture discussions, suggest improvements, and help maintain high code standards.
  • Collaborate with the client’s team on project tasks in English.

 

What we expect

  • Strong understanding of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
  • Solid hands-on experience with React.
  • Strong knowledge Node.js and frameworks like Nest.js or Express.
  • Experience building APIs with Node.js-based frameworks.
  • Understanding of relational and NoSQL databases such as Postgres, MongoDB, Firebase, or Supabase.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable code following best practices.
  • English level: Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher.

 

Additional advantages

  • Experience working with major cloud providers such as AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with React Native.
  • Solid understanding of Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Practical experience working with AI/LLM integrations in projects.

 

What we offer

  • Engaging projects built with a modern, well-supported tech stack.
  • A review process that ensures consistent feedback and knowledge sharing.
  • A culture focused on continuous learning and professional development.
  • Full remote work with a team distributed across multiple countries.
  • Competitive compensation in USD with periodic performance reviews.
  • Flexible payment methods tailored to your location.
  • Work schedule aligned with your time zone.
  • English practice sessions.
  • Paid sick leave and annual vacation (15 business days).
  • Regular team activities online.
  • Coverage of monthly psychologist support sessions.

item.title: Fullstack Developer Trainee
item.description:
We are looking for a trainee in Software Development who wants to grow into a Full Stack Developer. You should be a self-motivated person, eager to learn and apply modern technologies (including AI) to build real solutions for the company. You will work on internal tools, automations, and custom software across front-end and back-end: user interfaces, APIs, databases, integrations, and deployments.

You won’t know everything on day one, but you will learn quickly. Expect to contribute to real company projects within your first months. You will work closely with experienced developers and receive mentorship. Over time you should take ownership of small tasks and grow into an independent engineer. This is a long-term opportunity and a potential career path, not just an internship.

 

 

What to expect from your work

 

Tech stack you will work with for sure:

  • JavaScript/TypeScript
  • React
  • Node.js
  • REST APIs
  • PostgreSQL / MongoDB
  • Git & GitHub

AI-related stack

  • OpenAI API (automation, text generation, integrations)
  • Cursor / AI-assisted development tools

Domains & areas

Business-related

  • Internal tools & dashboards
  • Business process automation
  • Operations & CRM systems

Tech-related

  • Front-end development (React UI)
  • Back-end development (Node.js APIs)
  • Database design & queries
  • API integrations
  • Basic DevOps & deployment

Things you may work with later

  • Next.js
  • Docker
  • AWS / DigitalOcean
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • Microservices architecture

  • Infrastructure as Code

     

Requirements for the candidate

Must have:

  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript
  • Understanding of how web applications work (frontend + backend basics)
  • Strong motivation to learn and grow

  • Full Stack Development

     

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with React or Node.js (even pet projects)
  • Understanding of REST APIs
  • Experience with databases
  • Familiarity with Git

 

No required:

  • Commercial experience
  • Perfect English
  • Knowledge of the full tech stack

We care more about your learning ability, mindset, and motivation.

We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not match 100% of the list.

 

About the company

We provide:

  • Custom Software Development Services
  • UX/UI Design Services
  • Recruitment Services
  • Outstaffing Services

We believe in people, because that is the core of any company: clients and employees.

 

We value people who are smart, proactive, and genuinely enjoy what they do.

item.title: Full-Stack Developer (PostgreSQL, інтеграції, n8n)
item.description:
Шукаємо Full-Stack Developer (PostgreSQL, інтеграції, n8n), який/яка побудує та підтримуватиме централізовану інфраструктуру даних і автоматизацій компанії.

Основний фокус — PostgreSQL, n8n, REST API та власна backend-логіка. Нам потрібен інженерний підхід: не просто збирати workflow з готових блоків, а проєктувати структуру даних, писати код, розуміти роботу API та забезпечувати надійність рішень.

Що потрібно робити

  • Проєктувати та розвивати PostgreSQL: структуру БД, зв’язки, індекси, права доступу, міграції.
  • Переносити дані з Airtable та інших сервісів у централізовану БД.
  • Розробляти та підтримувати автоматизації в n8n, включно з кастомною логікою на JavaScript.
  • Будувати інтеграції через REST API та webhooks, працювати з авторизацією, пагінацією та rate limits.
  • За потреби створювати невеликі backend-сервіси та API на FastAPI / Node.js.
  • Забезпечувати обробку помилок, логування, моніторинг та стабільність workflow.
  • Документувати рішення та взаємодіяти з внутрішніми замовниками й DevOps.

Що очікуємо

  • Практичний досвід з PostgreSQL та SQL.
  • Розуміння проєктування реляційних БД.
  • Досвід роботи з REST API та інтеграціями.
  • Знання JavaScript/TypeScript або Python.
  • Досвід автоматизації бізнес-процесів.
  • Розуміння Git, Docker та базових принципів CI/CD.
  • Здатність самостійно розбиратися в документації та проєктувати технічні рішення.

Буде плюсом: досвід з n8n, FastAPI, Node.js, self-hosted рішеннями, Redis/message queues, monitoring та data migration.

item.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer (.NET + React)
item.description:
Loankea is a US mortgage lender. We build and run our own software: a workspace for our staff and a portal where borrowers apply and follow their case. Both are in production and used every day.

 

You would be the second engineer on this codebase, working directly with the person who built it, and you would carry a task from the issue to production yourself.

 

Besides the product itself, you would build internal tools and automations for the team, including AI agents for specific business processes.

 

We are looking for someone who is comfortable with both backend and frontend development, uses AI tools daily, and is accountable for every line they submit, whether they or an agent wrote it.

 

Requirements

• 1+ year of commercial development experience

• C# and .NET: async, LINQ, dependency injection

• React and TypeScript

• PostgreSQL or another relational database

• AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar

• Comfortable working in an existing codebase and following the conventions already in place

• Writing tests and debugging

• English B1+

 

Main Stack

• Backend: C#, .NET 10, GraphQL (HotChocolate), EF Core, PostgreSQL, Azure

• Frontend: TypeScript, React 19, Apollo Client, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI

• Testing: xUnit, Vitest, Testing Library, Testcontainers

• Tools: Git, GitHub Actions, Docker

• AI: Claude Code

 

GraphQL is a plus, not a requirement. It runs through the whole stack here, and if you have not used it, we will teach you.

item.title: Full-Stack Engineer (React / NestJS) HealthTech
item.description:
Dokport is a Finnish digital health company building a next level telemedicine service for individuals and an occupational health platform for companies in Finland and other EU countries.

Our product and engineering team works across multiple projects, with 1–3 people assigned to each project. You should be comfortable collaborating with others and taking responsibility for a project independently. Sometimes, you will be the main engineer on a project: understanding user needs, making technical and product decisions, and taking it from idea to production.

We don’t expect you to know everything in advance. We value ownership, quick learning and the ability to get things working in production.
 

Tech stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query
  • Backend: NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, REST APIs
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud, Docker, Terraform / OpenTofu, GitHub
  • Claude Code (mostly), ChatGPT, Gemini


Work format

  • Full-time
  • Remote
  • Long-term cooperation
  • We can help with relocation to Helsinki where possible
     

What you’ll do

  • Build and ship features across frontend and backend
  • Take ownership of projects from idea to production
  • Understand user needs and help decide how features should work
  • Make technical and product decisions independently when needed
  • Design APIs and backend services
  • Work with PostgreSQL schemas, queries and migrations
  • Build and maintain real-time features such as chat
  • Integrate third-party services for payments, e-signatures, invoicing and email
  • Debug production issues and improve existing systems
  • Review code and contribute to technical decisions
     

Requirements

  • 1.5+ years of production experience with TypeScript, React and Node.js
  • 1+ year working with PostgreSQL or another SQL database
  • 6+ months of hands-on experience with Redis, WebSockets (Socket.IO) and a cloud platform — we use Google Cloud
  • Experience shipping and maintaining web applications used by real users
  • Ability to work independently and take a feature from idea to production
  • You actively use AI-assisted development tools in your daily work
  • English at B2 level or higher for daily written communication
     

Nice to have

  • NestJS or Next.js
  • Docker
  • Terraform / OpenTofu
  • Automated testing with Vitest, Jest or Playwright

Healthcare experience is not required.

item.title: Power Platform Full-stack Specialist
item.description:
PwC is a global network of more than 370,000 professionals in 149 countries that turns challenges into opportunities. We create innovative solutions in audit, consulting, tax and technology, combining knowledge from all over the world.

 

PwC SDC Lviv, opened in 2018, is part of this global space. It is a place where technology is combined with team spirit, and ambitious ideas find their embodiment in real projects for Central and Eastern Europe.

 

What do we guarantee?

  • Work format: Remote or in a comfortable office in Lviv — you choose.
  • Development: Personal development plan, mentoring, English and Polish language courses.
  • Stability: Official employment from day one, annual review of salary and career prospects.
  • Corporate culture: Events that unite the team and a space where everyone can be themselves.

 

We are seeking a Power Platform Full-Stack Associate to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and support of business applications and process automation solutions built on Microsoft Power Platform.

You will collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, and solution architects to deliver scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and support digital transformation initiatives.

 

This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop expertise across the Power Platform ecosystem while working on enterprise-level projects.

 

Your responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Power Apps Canvas Applications.
  • Build and support Power Automate cloud flows to automate business processes.
  • Develop solutions leveraging Dataverse, SharePoint, and SQL data sources.
  • Implement business logic using Power Fx.
  • Create and maintain reusable components and application design patterns.
  • Work with APIs, JSON payloads, and integrations with external systems.
  • Participate in solution deployment and environment management across development and production environments.
  • Troubleshoot application and workflow issues and provide ongoing support.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Stay current with emerging Microsoft Power Platform and AI capabilities.

 

Key Requirements:

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience with Power Apps and/or Power Automate.
  • Experience building applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Understanding of Power Fx formulas and application logic.
  • Experience working with Dataverse, SharePoint, or SQL databases.
  • Basic understanding of relational database concepts and SQL queries.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and JSON.
  • Knowledge of Git and version control principles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, or CSS.
  • Power Platform CLI and custom connectors.
  • Azure Functions and Microsoft Graph API.
  • Power BI integration.
  • Power Automate Desktop (RPA).
  • Microsoft Copilot Studio or AI Builder.
  • CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Knowledge of Power Platform governance and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies.

 

Policy statements:
www.pwc.com/ua/uk/about/privacy.html

Привіт! Ми — команда BUYO Network і шукаємо Full-stack Developer рівня Strong Junior / Middle, який хоче не просто закривати задачі, а розбиратися в продукті та впливати на його розвиток.

Ми розвиваємо внутрішню платформу для performance-маркетингу, media buying та e-commerce. Система об'єднує рекламні дані, ліди, CRM-замовлення, товари, логістику, фінанси, аналітику, Telegram-ботів та зовнішні інтеграції.

Проєкт активно росте, тому шукаємо людину, яка вміє працювати з уже існуючим кодом, самостійно розбиратися в бізнес-логіці та доводити задачі до робочого результату.

Формат роботи

Робота повністю віддалена.

Основна комунікація — Telegram, задачі ведемо в Jira, за потреби проводимо короткі дзвінки.

Графік досить гнучкий, але розраховуємо на повну зайнятість і регулярну доступність протягом робочого дня.

Що потрібно буде робити

  • розвивати backend на Python / FastAPI;
  • працювати з frontend на React / TypeScript;
  • підтримувати REST API, webhooks і зовнішні інтеграції;
  • працювати з PostgreSQL, міграціями та аналітичними запитами;
  • розвивати таблиці, фільтри, форми, дашборди та фінансові розрахунки;
  • підтримувати фонові задачі, кешування та Telegram-ботів;
  • виправляти помилки, рефакторити існуючі рішення;
  • покривати критичну бізнес-логіку тестами;
  • брати відповідальність за окремі модулі та задачі.

Наш стек

Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic 2, asyncio, aiohttp. 

DB: PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2 async, asyncpg, Alembic.

Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, React Router, Redux Toolkit, Axios, Material UI, Emotion / SCSS. 

Інфраструктура: Redis, APScheduler, Linux, Git. Інтеграції: REST API, webhooks, Telegram, Google Sheets, Facebook, CRM та ERP.

Що для нас важливо

  • хороша база в Python, FastAPI та асинхронному коді;
  • досвід із PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2 та Alembic;
  • розуміння REST API, JSON, webhooks та інтеграцій;
  • досвід із React та TypeScript;
  • React Hooks, React Router, Redux Toolkit, Axios;
  • базове розуміння Redis та APScheduler;
  • Git і клієнт-серверна архітектура;
  • уміння працювати з існуючим кодом і самостійно розбиратися в бізнес-логіці.

Не потрібно однаково добре знати весь стек.

Для Strong Junior важлива сильна база в Python, мінімальний практичний досвід із React і бажання розвиватися у full-stack напрямі.

Від Middle очікуємо більшої самостійності та можливості вести задачу від бази даних і backend-логіки до готового інтерфейсу.
